integrity: The complete face census, explicitly checked pure shelling, all link orbit computations and integral oriented torus cycle are reproducible from two standalone included programs. The proof invokes standard links-of-shellable-complexes and closed-surface classification theorems.
limitations: Exact result for the graph C16(1,4,8), not a general circulant theorem; does not identify the ambient homeomorphism type or certify independent priority. The global S3 is only a homotopy equivalence.
title: A torus of rank-two local homology inside a shellable flag homotopy sphere
